features: 1.【Extra Thick &Double Border Technology】Innovative"Double Border Pillow Top Construction" technology not only prevents filling from moving or leak out, also enables this mattress topper overstuffed with 60% more filling, which is far beyond than average on the market. 2.【Breathable & Durable Materials】Made of carefully selected 1500 series, the fabric is breathable, quick dry and shrink-resistant, a durable and smart choice for you. Processed with Peach skin finish, it brings a cozy feeling to touch, also wicks moisture, keeps your skin dry and cool. No more sweaty nights caused by memory foam or traditional mattresses.

3.【Easier & Healthier Solution】Without any odor of feather and extra heat build-up, a healthier solution is produced for your valuable sleep. By adding premium cushioning 4D spiral fiber and luxurious 1500 series, relief your body and mind, enjoy the benefits of an affordable down alternative mattress topper.
